description: Search the Minneapolis Institute of Art collection (~90k objects). Accepts free text ("monet water lilies") or Elasticsearch field syntax: artist:"Van Gogh", country:"China", department:"Asian Art", room:G3* — combinable with free text. Returns artist, date, medium, gallery location (on-view status), and image URL. Keyless.

on_view_only.description: If true, only return artworks currently on view in a gallery.

query.description: Free text or ES query-string field syntax. Examples: "monet", 'artist:"Van Gogh"', 'horse country:"China"', 'department:"European Art"'.

name: search_artworks
title: Search Artworks
